defectsCorrected: A completed setup is now armed explicitly and is consumed on fill.
An unused setup is cancelled by a completed opposite setup.
An armed long setup is invalidated if a later close has low at or below SMA18 before the breakout.
A bearish setup can exit a long only if it completed after that long was opened.
Same-bar entry and exit is not assumed. An open long that can exit does not also enter.
